validate_proto_message: validate a protobuf message against protoc-gen-validate rules and raise ValidationFailed on errors
check_field_has_validate: check if a protobuf field has validate.rules options defined using has_validate
generate_validation_code: generate and cache Python validation code for a protobuf message class using file_template
validate_email_hostname: validate an email address or hostname using the _validateEmail and _validateHostName helper functions
validate_string_constraints: validate string fields against length, pattern, prefix, suffix, email, hostname, IP, URI, and UUID constraints
